Not published.** Dave Thompson · Council · incumbent (2022–26 City term) · **also standing for the CRD Board**. Re-verified **2 Sep 2026** against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026, plus the 1 Sep 2026 changelog)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom and is Joa's to apply or reject. Alignment compute APPLIED letter for Thompson stays **—**. **Second pass, 2 Sep 2026.** The full site was enumerated from `post-sitemap.xml` and `page-sitemap.xml` (132 posts, 6 pages). The first pass read 4 posts; this pass read **26 sources with a 2026 date**. **n moved 1 → 10.** Three corrections are recorded in Working notes: the 12 May cooling motion, the 19 Jan camera motions and the 12 May OCP remarks were wrongly set aside as "this-term Record" on the first pass. Under Decision 14 **Commits = "an action they will take *or have taken*"**, so a 2026 post describing his own motion is 2026 campaign text and scores. ## Card

At OCP adoption: "We will allow a wider variety of homes, and yes corner stores, in more neighbourhoods." **No unit target and no composition share.** [18 Mar post](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/new-homes-vacancy-rates-and-rents/) · [OCP remarks](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/ocp-adoption-my-remarks/) 2026-03-18 · 2026-05-12, retrieved 2026-09-02

Written program — **yes** Authorized 2026 site, current, with a dated blog. "I'm standing for re-election to Victoria City Council and the CRD Board on October 17, and I'm putting together my platform." Six preliminary priority areas, explicitly consultative. **Written and current; no costed platform, no targets, no dates.** [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/my-re-election-platform-your-ideas-are-welcome-as-always/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/my-re-election-platform-your-ideas-are-welcome-as-always/) published 2026-06-23, updated 2026-08-26, retrieved 2026-09-02
## Rules (Joa, 2 Sep 2026) **What you score.** Every candidate, same 12 topics, same measures inside them. You are measuring distance from the written Program, not picking a favourite. **What counts, in order.** 1. **Actions.** If they held office and a sourced vote or decision contradicts a 2026 promise, the action counts. 2. **Words.** A 2026 campaign sentence with a URL and a date. 3. **Silence.** No public answer is a dash. A dash is unknown, not a fail. **When a letter appears.** Only after 5 scored answers (across the 55 measures that sit in the 12). Under 5, they stay a dash. The number next to the letter is how many measures have a scored answer. **What the letter is.** One overall mark (Decision 14: B+, B, C, D, or —). It is not an endorsement and not a ranking of people. Area columns stay blank. The five doors on the front (tax cap, downtown order, housing, household bill, written program) are said / record / yes / dash — a sourced sentence or a fact, never a second grade. ### Filling a cell - **answer** = the mark (Aligned 3.0 · Close 2.0 · Partial+ 1.5 · Partial 1.0 · Weak 0.5 · Opposed −1.0) or `📋 Record` or `—`. - **quote or fact** = one verbatim sentence, or the vote / decision in one line. - **URL + date** = the source and its date (vote date, or page lastmod plus retrieved date). No URL + date = dash. - **Actions over words:** when a sourced vote or decision contradicts the 2026 sentence, score the action and put the sentence under it as context. A sourced miss on an incumbent (held office 2022–26) caps that cell below Close. A Record line that does not contradict a 2026 promise stays `📋 Record`, shown, not scored. - **One sentence, one measure.** A sentence already scored on one measure cannot carry a second mark on another, inside or outside its topic. - **Ambiguity resolves upward.** Between two marks, give the higher one. - **Not a source:** frame or tone · a stated lane · bloc membership on other files · third-party endorsement · professional background or a seat held · absence of action (that is Record, not Opposed) · adjacency. **Could this mark be defended to the candidate's face, with the source in hand?** If not, dash. - **Every change goes to** **with a date.** ### Compute reference (Decision 14) **Q1 · shares the goal?** Commits (states an action they will take or have taken) · Agrees (names it as a goal, no action) · Mentions (raises it, no goal → dash, every column) · Disagrees (vote against or explicit opposition). **Q2 · how?** Same instrument · Comparable instrument · A target, no instrument · Neither.
Q1 ↓ · Q2 → Same instrument Comparable instrument Target, no instrument Neither
**Commits** Aligned 3.0 Close 2.0 Partial+ 1.5 Partial 1.0
**Agrees** Close 2.0 Partial+ 1.5 Partial 1.0 Weak 0.5
**Mentions** — — — —
**Disagrees** Opposed −1.0 Opposed −1.0 Opposed −1.0 Opposed −1.0
**Live letter is applied, not computed.** Decision 14 letters (B+, B, C, D, or —) wait for Joa's click. Compute must not overwrite them. The matrix above is how you *propose* a letter to yourself — not how the live card is written. **Propose internally (do not publish as the live letter):** mean of scored answers, at 5 or more. Bands: A 2.75–3.00 · A− 2.50–2.74 · B+ 2.25–2.49 · B 2.00–2.24 · B− 1.75–1.99 · C+ 1.50–1.74 · C 1.25–1.49 · C− 1.00–1.24 · D 0.50–0.99 · F below 0.50. Letters in use on the live card: B+, B, C, D, —. **Cell format, one line:** `Aligned 3.0 · "quoted sentence" · context · URL · lastmod DD Mmm 2026, retrieved 2 Sep 2026` ## The 12 topics No topic gets its own letter. Area columns stay blank. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Partial 1.0** **Commits + neither.** 18 Mar 2026: committed to approving more multifamily homes — "I'm committed to doing so". Volume without a unit target and without a composition share, so none of M6's instrument (12,000 homes; 25% missing middle; 20% 3BR+; 15% below-market; 30% PBR, quarterly reported). The 4% vacancy discussion in that post is analysis, not a City target. 📋 Record YES on Missing Middle 26 Jan 2023, named — matches, not in n. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/new-homes-vacancy-rates-and-rents/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/new-homes-vacancy-rates-and-rents/) 2026-03-18, retrieved 2026-09-02 · Record 2023-01-26
2 M6b land bank + co-ops — No land bank, no public land inventory, no acquisition fund, no ROFR, no co-ops. City-owned land appears only as reporting — "This BC Housing and CRD project on City-donated land will be a 20 storey building that includes 158 affordable homes" — which is a description of a project, not an instrument he proposes. Mention = dash. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/) 2026-03-19, retrieved 2026-09-02
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — Nothing on permit times, service standards, a one-stop centre, a tenure-priority queue or AI pre-screening, in any 2026 source. 26 sources read. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs and a pattern book do not appear in any 2026 source. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty **Close 2.0** **Commits + comparable instrument.** OCP adoption, 12 May 2026: "We will allow a wider variety of homes, and yes corner stores, in more neighbourhoods." · "We are going to go back to allowing homeowners a wider range of choices on what to do with their property." City-wide land-use liberalisation is comparable to M8's pre-zoning leg, but **it is not the same instrument**: no 5% vacancy target, no DCC reduction for purpose-built rental, no suite amnesty. 📋 Record, matching, not in n: he moved a motion with Coun. Loughton directing staff to examine house conversions, eliminating parking minimums and multiple suites on a single property — carried 6–3. [OCP remarks](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/ocp-adoption-my-remarks/) · Record: [Capital Daily 8 Jan 2023](https://www.capitaldaily.ca/news/housing-motion-victoria-city-council) 2026-05-12, retrieved 2026-09-02 · Record Jan 2023
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team 📋 Record "a Police and Bylaw **field hub** will soon be opening in the Neighbour Building at 999 Pandora" · "city council funded the additional police foot patrols". A co-located police-and-bylaw hub is adjacent to M26's co-located operations desk, but **he reports it, he does not propose it** — no unified command, no 8 AM briefing, no single field supervisor, no Public Works or outreach leg. He is not individually named on the funding vote. Shown, not scored. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/) 2026-03-19, retrieved 2026-09-02
7 M26b civilian crisis response — No crisis-worker dispatch, no published dispatch criteria, no diversion figure. His Detox-Treatment-Recovery Navigator is a treatment-access instrument and is scored once, on row 23 (one sentence, one measure). — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours, no officer-shift number, no funding source. "Safer streets" in the 25 Aug priorities is a Mention and does not resolve up. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — Foot patrols are reported as presence, not as hotspot-data deployment. No weekly hotspot process, no Crown coordination, no focused deterrence. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — No 2026 position on the existing overnight-sheltering rules or on enforcement capacity. **FLAG: he is unnamed on the 18 Jul 2024 press. Do not invent a roll-call and do not convert silence into a mark.** — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — "**The ban on open drug use is now being enforced**." He reports provincial-law enforcement by a new chief; he proposes no posted protected list around child-focused spaces and no City buffer instrument. Mention = dash. The enforcement is VicPD's decision, not his. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/) 2026-03-19, retrieved 2026-09-02
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting **Weak 0.5** **Agrees + neither.** "Bringing people indoors means they can stabilize, and more easily access and be accessed by providers of services, such as detox and addiction treatment." That is M35's capacity-first principle, and he enumerates the capacity coming online (Pathways 34, Rock Bay 30, Johnson Manor 20, Salvation Army ARC 13, Village on the Green 32, 926–930 Pandora 47). **He names no instrument in this topic:** no rapid-removal protocol, no 5 PM capacity dashboard, no reclaiming-spaces deployment, no all-night lighting. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/) 2026-03-19, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) 📋 Record Supported the 2026 financial plan; the recorded opponents were Kim, Hammond and Gardiner. His 4 Jun post explains the number — "The overall tax increase is 7.28%." and "5.06 percentage points (about 70% of the entire increase) is attributable to the police budget increases" — **the same arithmetic the Program uses.** Explaining a bill is not capping one: no residential-rate cap, no glide path, no supermajority override. No 2026 promise is contradicted, so shown and not in n. [4 Jun post](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/setting-the-record-straight-on-property-taxes/) · [vicnews 13 Mar 2026](https://vicnews.com/2026/03/13/victoria-faces-7-2-tax-increase-as-council-laments-compromises-in-budget/) post 2026-06-04 · budget 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no debt-service ceiling, no supermajority override. Nothing in 26 sources. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — Water, sewer, solid waste, stormwater and the single combined household figure do not appear anywhere. **This is the sharpest gap on the card given the CRD seat** — see Working notes. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — No quarterly downloading ledger, no published refusal threshold, no UBCM/FCM resolution programme. He argues police cost is not council's to set, which is a description of jurisdiction, not a ledger. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The filtration plant, regional water rates, a City position on regional cost and a published CRD voting record do not appear. **He is a sitting CRD director standing for re-election to that board.** Dash is unknown, not a fail — but this is the first question to put to him. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Partial 1.0** **Agrees + a target, no instrument.** OCP adoption, 12 May 2026: "This was a motion to add a tangible, aspirational goal of **building 1,500 hotel rooms by 2035**." A named, dated sector target, adopted in his own remarks. **No instrument:** no storefront-vacancy target, no vacant-property licensing, no Strategic Economic Plan, no single mandate. **Authorship of the motion is not established** — if he moved it this rises to Partial+ 1.5. Scored conservatively. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/ocp-adoption-my-remarks/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/ocp-adoption-my-remarks/) 2026-05-12, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No \$25M capital-approval threshold, no 15-minute grace, no real-time stall counts, no small-renovation fee schedule. **His parking answers sit in a 2022 questionnaire and are excluded by rule.** The Jan 2023 parking-minimums motion is a Record and is already shown on row 5. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — "furthering our respectful work with the First Nations" is one clause inside a preliminary priorities list: no G2G table, no procurement standard, no place-names programme, no liaison post. Mention = dash. **His professional background co-founding a firm serving Indigenous communities is explicitly not a source** and is not used here. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/my-re-election-platform-your-ideas-are-welcome-as-always/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/my-re-election-platform-your-ideas-are-welcome-as-always/) 2026-08-26, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Aligned 3.0** **Commits + same instrument.** "This week, Councillors Caradonna, Dell, and I will bring a motion that would be the first step toward requiring landlords to allow and/or provide cooling in Victoria's rental buildings." · "Our motion asks staff to look at what tools the City has to **restrict landlords from blocking cooling equipment**, or to require heat pumps or other passive cooling measures." That is M64's step 1 word for word — ban unreasonable landlord prohibition of portable cooling, carried by the Standards of Maintenance Bylaw or the business-licence power. The motion also asks staff to write to the Province so upgrades do not trigger renovictions, which touches M9. **Only the 26°C performance rule and the enforcement FTE are gated in the Program; step 1 is not.** [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/keeping-renters-safe-why-victoria-needs-a-maximum-indoor-temperature/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/keeping-renters-safe-why-victoria-needs-a-maximum-indoor-temperature/) 2026-05-12, retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — "Placements into the above spaces will be for people who are already in Victoria and are on existing lists." · "Residents will be selected through BC Housing and matched with appropriate services." He describes BC Housing's process; he proposes no City portal, no point scoring, no published queue position. Mention = dash. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/) 2026-03-19, retrieved 2026-09-02
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput **Close 2.0** **Commits + comparable instrument.** "I brought a motion to help people get into the Detox-Treatment-Recovery System." · "A **Detox-Treatment-Recovery System Access Navigator** could proactively approach people on the streets." · "This would not be a wide-ranging social worker or health-care worker, but rather a person whose only job is to reach out to people and help them contact appropriate offices." A named, targeted throughput role — comparable to M11's case-managed STEP pathway, **but on the treatment system rather than the housing ladder**, with no 50% unsheltered target and no published cost-per-placement. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/helping-people-access-the-detox-treatment-recovery-pathway/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/helping-people-access-the-detox-treatment-recovery-pathway/) 2026-06-30, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) **Close 2.0** **Commits + comparable instrument.** "I was very happy to **move a successful Victoria Council motion** calling on the provincial government to: create the Student Food Security Grant called for in the Backgrounder; set a **\$10 flat-rate ferry fare for students** foot passengers; and **explore and consult with student advocacy organizations** in relation to all 15 of the recommendations made in the Backgrounder." The fare leg and the student-consultation leg are comparable to M13c's fare partnership and Youth Voice, **delivered as provincial advocacy rather than a City instrument.** Nothing on childcare spaces (M12) or family doctors (M13b). [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/affordability-and-safety-for-students/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/affordability-and-safety-for-students/) 2026-05-12, retrieved 2026-09-02
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — No SD61 agreement, joint work plan, joint-use facilities or single contact. The Student Food Security Grant is provincial and is already scored once, on row 24. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — "Keeping public spaces like sidewalks and parks clear of waste and items that the owner cannot or will not move is a function of the City." · "To ask for an area to be cleaned up, contact Public Works." A how-to-report explainer, not a service standard: no 48-hour graffiti target, no dispatch route, no rat plan, no extended sanitation hours. Mention = dash. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/street-problems-where-to-advocate-for-improvements/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/street-problems-where-to-advocate-for-improvements/) updated 2026-08-25, retrieved 2026-09-02
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Aligned 3.0** **Commits + same instrument, twice.** Cameras (M40 as rewritten to advocacy): "I made a motion in 2023 at Committee of the Whole" asking the Province to install safety cameras at high-crash locations or permit municipalities to do so at their own expense · "This motion passed unanimously at Committee and Council" · "I gave notice of a similar motion at the CRD Transportation Committee" · "The next steps rest with the Provincial Government." Protected lanes (M41): he and Coun. Dell brought a motion to fill two network gaps, and his 2024 Shelbourne motion carried unanimously. **Caveat for Joa: M19 adaptive signals is unmatched — the mark rests on M40 and M41, both of which remain in the Program. Downgrade to Close 2.0 if you want the flagship instrument to govern the cluster.** [cameras](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/time-for-more-red-light-and-speed-cameras/) · [bike gaps](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/closing-two-gaps-in-the-protected-bike-and-roll-mobility-network/) 2026-01-19 · 2026-05-12, retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — No sidewalk gap inventory, no crossing-spacing standard, no pedestrian collision publication, no named transit capital line, no published annual City transit position. The peer-city benchmarking post is about bike-and-roll lanes and is already scored once, on row 27. The streetcar post is historical maps with no commitment. Regional trail widening is a CRD capital file, not a City sidewalk standard. [streetcar maps](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/victoria-streetcar-maps/) · [trails](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/regional-trail-widening/) 2026-08-10 · 2026-05-26, retrieved 2026-09-02
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — No accessibility audit, no curb-cut programme, no Disability Advisory Committee, no 24/7 washroom standard. The Pandora washroom post carries a 2025 lastmod and is outside 2026 campaign text. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — No sequencing rule, no pothole report-to-fix standard, no rehabilitation priority. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — No cost-spreading pilot, no exposure-based reimbursement, no defined zone. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — No community-paramedicine partnership and no urban-mandate advocacy. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) 📋 Record Council cut VicPD's four-officer ask to two on 3 Mar 2026, carried 5–4; the four opponents are named (Coleman, Gardiner, Hammond, Alto), so on a nine-member council he is in the majority **by exclusion, not by a named roll-call**. The board appealed on 16 Jun 2026. His own 2026 position points a different way from the Program: "I'd love to see it changed to **eliminate council's middleman role**" — that is not M29's renegotiated cost-share formula and not M29b's convened regional review. **No 2026 promise of his is contradicted, so this is shown and not scored.** [Victoria Buzz 4 Mar 2026](https://victoriabuzz.com/2026/03/victoria-council-cuts-two-new-vicpd-officers-from-police-budget-request/) · [appeal](https://vicnews.com/2026/06/22/victoria-police-board-to-appeal-citys-2026-budget/) · [his post](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/public-input-opposed-to-police-budget-increase-and-what-that-means/) vote 2026-03-03 · appeal 2026-06-16 · post 2026-06-04, retrieved 2026-09-02

Mention = dash. [https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/](https://davethompsonvictoria.ca/change-is-happening-on-pandora/) 2026-03-19, retrieved 2026-09-02

### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
